Estimated from the photo, using the plate as a ruler (about 26 cm square dinner plate).

Items on the plate:
- Sliced roast meat, roughly 80-90 g, about 130 kcal.
- Cauliflower, about 150 g, about 40 kcal.
- Roasted potatoes, about 100 g, about 150 kcal.
- Chicken pieces, about 70 g, about 120 kcal.
- Patty or croquette, about 60 g, about 140 kcal.

That adds up to roughly 470 g and 580 kcal. Allowing for some oil and seasoning, I settled on slightly higher figures.
